milestones.title: Published roadmap

criteria.text: Reassessment and staged roadmap published
Demo scope and longer-term acceptance gates documented

milestones.next_action: Review task contracts and assign implementation owners.

criteria.text: Three workflows linked to versioned tutorial segments
Approximately 15–25 requirements have observable expected results
Scientific definitions and baseline evidence reviewed

milestones.title: Executable analysis and durable handoff

criteria.text: Typed records and five traceability queries produce reproducible findings
Didactopus pack validates before graph QA; invalid and stale inputs tested
GroundRecall handoff retrieved in a fresh context and checked against Git

milestones.next_action: Implement the smallest useful graph adapter and report.

milestones.title: Complete demonstration workflow

criteria.text: Configure, run, inspect, save, reopen, and compare work from a clean session
Preset controls, update target, records, and plots pass focused checks
English and Spanish visual checks recorded; review limitations explicit

milestones.next_action: Repair the highest-impact demonstrated gap; freeze feature scope October 15.

milestones.title: Verification and rehearsal

criteria.text: Presentation laptop and second browser workflow checks recorded
Desktop, narrow layout, keyboard, localization, and error recovery reviewed
Two timed rehearsals and known-limitations record completed

Every UI element described as functional or available in the port assessment receives desktop and narrow-layout visual review; defects are fixed or recorded with evidence. Verify the Organism view selector placement and ensure primary content remains unobscured.

milestones.next_action: Complete second-browser, keyboard, localization, error-recovery, and timed-rehearsal checks.

evidence.label: Desktop and narrow visual audit, 30 September 2026

milestones.title: Candidate freeze and BEACON demonstration

criteria.text: Candidate tagged with source revisions, image digest, and exports
Pages and local server checked; cached data and labeled recording ready
October 23 demonstration delivered and follow-up observations recorded

milestones.next_action: Freeze October 20; rehearse October 21–22; demonstrate October 23.

milestones.title: Release scope and scientific contracts

criteria.text: Supported curriculum and tutorial task inventory reviewed with instructors
Metrics, engine profiles, and reproducibility boundaries agreed
Preserved, redesigned, deferred, and unsupported requirements recorded

milestones.next_action: Expand scope after the demo; review may begin earlier without displacing it.

milestones.title: Population, Freezer, and persistence

criteria.text: Supported population settings, controls, measurements, and colors verified
Tutorial-relevant transfers and keyboard alternatives work
Versioned artifact, result, and checkpoint round trips preserve metadata

milestones.next_action: Complete the population and data foundation before full Analysis.

milestones.title: Organism and Analysis continuity

criteria.text: Organism execution and isolated evaluation meet reviewed contracts
Up to three populated dishes and supported axes, colors, and exports work in Analysis
Selected tutorial walkthroughs pass with explicit exceptions

milestones.next_action: Restore supported legacy workflows while retaining the separate lesson comparison.

milestones.title: Curriculum, access, localization, and pilot

criteria.text: Supported activities, prompts, rubrics, and contextual help reviewed
Spanish, accessibility, and browser/device acceptance completed
Classroom pilot resolves critical defects; maintainers record release decision

milestones.next_action: Pilot complete supported activities; distinguish usability evidence from learning claims.
